title: Send Telegram message
description: Sends a text message to a Telegram chat.

connectionId.title: Telegram bot connection
connectionId.description: Telegram bot connection (token from @BotFather) used to send the message.

chatId.title: Chat ID
chatId.description: Telegram chat that receives the message: a numeric chat id or an @channel username.

parseMode.title: Parse mode
parseMode.description: Formatting of the message text: none (default), HTML or MarkdownV2.

disableNotification.title: Silent message
disableNotification.description: Send without a notification sound (true or false). Default false.

replyToMessageId.title: Reply to message ID
replyToMessageId.description: Id of a message in the same chat to reply to. A missing original does not fail the send.
